description: This file defines internal resolver-related functionality for gRPC, including interfaces and types for configuration selection, RPC info, client streams, interceptors, and thread-safe configuration switching.

classes.name: ClientStream
classes.description: Interface representing a gRPC client stream with methods for headers, trailers, sending, receiving, and context.

classes.name: ClientInterceptor
classes.description: Interface for intercepting and creating new client streams.

classes.name: ServerInterceptor
classes.description: Interface for intercepting incoming server RPCs.

classes.name: SafeConfigSelector
classes.description: Thread-safe wrapper for switching ConfigSelector implementations safely.

methods.name: SetConfigSelector
methods.description: Sets the ConfigSelector in resolver.State attributes.

methods.name: GetConfigSelector
methods.description: Retrieves the ConfigSelector from resolver.State attributes.

methods.name: UpdateConfigSelector
methods.description: Atomically swaps the current ConfigSelector with a new one, waiting for previous uses to complete.

methods.name: SelectConfig
methods.description: Delegates to the current ConfigSelector to select RPC configuration.
